purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel sources for Wichita, United States of America; claims are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Wichita

queries.query: Wichita Kansas official parcel map GIS Sedgwick County parcel viewer
queries.result: First-party Sedgwick County GIS and City of Wichita pages identify the public Mobile Land Records/property parcel map, Open Data GIS materials, and the Wichita ArcGIS REST Property_and_Location service. The service advertises a Parcels layer.

queries.query: Wichita Kansas official GIS parcel data ArcGIS REST Sedgwick County
queries.result: The same first-party local custodians and ArcGIS REST service were located. The layer metadata was accessible through the official REST endpoint; the bounded anonymous query from this host timed out before a feature response.

officialSources.observation: Sedgwick County GIS states it is the primary GIS provider for the Wichita/Sedgwick County region and links public mapping/data services.
Official local GIS data-layer page lists Property Data including Property Parcels and Lots.
Official City of Wichita page directs users to City and Sedgwick County public GIS viewers for property-related map layers.
Official City GIS ArcGIS REST layer metadata identifies Parcels, polygon geometry, EPSG/Web Mercator 3857 output reference, and anonymous query support.

requests.outcome: Succeeded via public REST metadata response. Layer name Parcels; geometryType esriGeometryPolygon; source WKID 102678/latest 3420; service/output spatial reference WKID 102100/latest 3857; maxRecordCount 2000; supported query formats JSON, geoJSON, PBF. Inspected fields included OBJECTID, PIN, GEOCODE, AIN, GlobalID and many additional fields; unsafe fields were not requested in the feature query.

requests.method: GET with where=1=1, point geometry=-97.3183527057913,37.6798820217102, geometryType=esriGeometryPoint, inSR=4326, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=OBJECTID,PIN,GEOCODE,AIN,GlobalID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson
requests.outcome: Timed out at 10 seconds from this host with no HTTP response. No exact-point hit or miss was inferred, and no geometry was retained.
Attempted as an alternate official county GIS route; this environment did not return an accessible response. No absence inference was made.

registryBasis: A local municipal/county public GIS parcel service is evidenced: City of Wichita GIS publishes the viewer route and Sedgwick County GIS identifies itself as the regional GIS provider. This is local GIS/cadastre-map evidence, not merely national agency prose.

nativeSchema.stableIdentityStatus: Not qualified because no feature response was obtained
safeAllowlist: stable native parcel ID when independently verified
nativeSchema.retainedPropertiesPolicy: No GeoJSON retained; if a future bounded response is retained, use exactly one independently verified canonical native identity as properties.id and omit raw source attributes.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sedgwick County GIS public parcel service covering the Wichita/Sedgwick County region.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official parcel layer metadata and polygon schema verified; no bounded feature geometry was returned in this attempt.

remainingUncertainty: The official local parcel layer is evidenced and likely usable, but the exact-point request timed out and no safe ID-plus-geometry response was independently inspected. A timeout is not evidence of citywide absence. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used; the WUP point was preserved exactly.
